newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-S.Pattinson can't explain share rise.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-S.Pattinson can't explain share rise.

text.p: Washington H. Soul Pattinson and Co Ltd said on Friday in response to a stock exchange query that it could not explain the rise in its share price, but noted that a broker had issued a report on its Indonesian coal interests.

The company, which has interest in mining, retail pharmacy, and television, said it had no announcement to make to the market but would issue its profit result for the year to July 31 on about October 9.
The stock exchange had queried the company about the rise in its share price from A$40.00 on July 18 to A$53.00 on Thursday.
Its shares were 50 cents higher at A$53.50 on Friday.
